title: MEDTAS adapter and Control Center reliability standard
purpose: Stop infrastructure defects from consuming engineering time and prevent one adapter failure from disabling unrelated project work.
rules: No compressed multi-subsystem PowerShell one-liners in production Control Center code.
Shared API functions live in one core module; server and self-test use the same implementation.
Every adapter must expose a read-only health/self-test path before it is allowed into the main workflow.
A failed optional subsystem must degrade independently; Git failure must not suppress State, Files, CAD or engineering views.
HTTP/API errors must return structured JSON containing endpoint and error text.
Server startup is blocked if the API-core contract self-test fails.
File-registry entries may use candidates, patterns or both; missing future evidence is a normal MISSING state, not an exception.
Writes to CAD/BOM/release state remain explicit controlled actions with backup and readback.
No platform feature is promoted merely because static code generation succeeded; local Windows/SOLIDWORKS runtime evidence is required.
After v8.4, platform changes are frozen except for defects that block K01 engineering execution until Gate04E/T03 and the first T04/T05 release evidence are completed.

subsystem_contracts.state: must serialize independently even if Git or Files fails
subsystem_contracts.git: must catch command/auth errors and return HOLD/degraded object rather than HTTP 500
subsystem_contracts.files: must isolate errors per registry entry
subsystem_contracts.solidworks: read-only bridge health separate from controlled CAD writers
subsystem_contracts.femm: installation/solver health separate from release-result status
subsystem_contracts.bom: metadata projection health separate from engineering release blockers
